name: Emergency Stop Latch
description: Latching fault state driven by safety inputs. Requires explicit Reset_PB to clear. Safety force-off placed LAST in scan to override all output assignments.
safety_notes: Emergency_Stop is normally-closed (NC): signal TRUE = healthy, FALSE = pressed. Force-off block MUST be last in scan. Fault_State uses self-latching: remains TRUE until Reset_PB clears it while E-Stop is healthy.
common_mistakes: Placing E-Stop check before CASE/output assignments — CASE will override the force-off
Using Emergency_Stop = TRUE as the fault trigger (NC logic is opposite)
Forgetting to reset step states when fault clears — motor restarts unexpectedly
